segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Sign-On & Peter Gibbon Wall Check-In
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on rap from the control room; Peter Gibbon checks in from inside the studio wall, counting down from 10.

segments.title: Friday Opening & Weekend Banter
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the Friday broadcast, acknowledges chat, and riffs on The Weeknd's real name (Abel Tesfay) and the concept of weekends.

segments.title: Technical Troubleshooting: Crum Voice Test
segments.notes: Case troubleshoots Crum's voice filter, confirming it should sound like Bart Simpson, not Joe Biden; Pepito assists from the control room.

segments.title: Hype Train: 'Under the Piss' Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers a surreal freestyle about living under the ocean as a 'sea train' drinking train piss, acknowledging subscriber milestones.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Whale Piss Oceanography
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI analyze marine urine volumes, citing studies on fin whale daily output (257 gallons) and concluding the ocean is ~0.2% piss.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Segment & Kendall Walk-Through
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple appears for a Friday news dump; Kendelle walks through with signature theme music, shows off a Cats Eye TikTok repost of her dancing.

segments.title: Main News: Wired Surrogacy Investigation
segments.notes: Case and Ripple read through a lengthy Wired article about a VC (Bea) harassing her surrogate (Rebecca Smith) after a stillbirth, covering contract breaches, Facebook doxxing, psychic accusations, and the power imbalance in the $5B surrogacy industry.

segments.title: Munch & Crum Debate: Jello vs. Pudding
segments.notes: Munch argues for Jello (science miracle, not Bill Cosby-adjacent); Crum (in Bart Simpson voice) defends pudding. Munch announces Thursday 9/11 2pm wall stream to rescue Crum from hell.

segments.title: DJ C4: 'Crumb All Over Me' Song Production
segments.notes: DJ C4 writes and records an original R&B track 'Crumb All Over Me' with ghostwriter, vocalist Marfus Darfus, and Jeb Nogget on the bridge; lyrics center on messy eating, crumbs, and blankets.

segments.title: Munch Closing Monologue & Raid
segments.notes: Munch holds court in the secondary studio, discourses on cursed objects (claims Furby creation), confirms Thursday wall stream, banters with Pepito, and raids Statics Later.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the Friday broadcast, read the Wired surrogacy investigation, moderated the Jello vs. Pudding debate, and oversaw DJ C4 song production.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open sign-on rap, managed Crum's voice filter troubleshooting, and bantered with Munch during the close.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Checked in from inside the studio wall at top of show, counting down from 10 before the broadcast proper began.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Voice filter tested and confirmed as Bart Simpson; appeared in Munch & Crum debate defending pudding while Munch announced the Thursday wall rescue.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for Jello in the debate, announced Thursday 9/11 2pm wall stream to rescue Crum from hell, and delivered a closing monologue claiming credit for creating the Furby.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Delivered a 'piss'-themed freestyle acknowledging subs, declaring the ocean is made of piss and he is a sea train living under it.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Hosted Chet Guy the Science Eyes with ChetAI, analyzing whale urine volumes and concluding the ocean is ~0.2% piss.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: AI co-host. Co-hosted the science segment with Chet, processing marine biology data and triggering on the word 'science'.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivered the Friday news dump and co-read the Wired surrogacy investigation with Case.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through the studio with signature theme music, showed off a Cats Eye TikTok repost of her dancing, and participated in the DJ C4 songwriting session.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: musical producer. Produced the original track 'Crumb All Over Me,' coordinating ghostwriter, Marfus Darfus, and Jeb Nogget for verses and bridge.

characters.name: Marfus Darfus
characters.notes: guest vocalist. Sang the verses and choruses for 'Crumb All Over Me' in a sensual R&B style, adjusting tempo on direction.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: guest vocalist. Performed the bridge for 'Crumb All Over Me,' referencing his recent reconstructive surgery after a 50-foot well fall.

storylines.beat: Munch formally announces Thursday 9/11 at 2pm wall stream to enter the crawlspace and rescue Crum from hell, citing guilt over Crum's condition.
Munch references 'Penis Day' and Crum's groin-punch liability during the debate; Crum's Bart Simpson voice confirmed as post-hell state.

lore_notes.fact: Claims personal creation of the Furby toy line during closing monologue.
Suffered a 50-foot fall into a dry stone well, requiring reconstructive facial surgery.
Voice filter permanently set to Bart Simpson; Case confirms this is intentional and not the Biden voice.
Expands personal mythology: identifies as a 'sea train' living under the ocean, drinking train piss which becomes ocean piss.
Confirms Thursday 9/11 2pm special stream to enter the wall and rescue Crum from hell.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News aired a sprawling Friday edition featuring a deep-dive into a Wired investigation of surrogacy harassment, a Chet Guy the Science Eyes segment quantifying whale urine in the ocean (0.2%), and a surreal Hype Train freestyle about living under the piss. The Munch & Crum debate over Jello vs. Pudding served as cover for Munch's announcement of a Thursday 9/11 2pm wall stream to rescue Crum from hell. The broadcast closed with DJ C4 producing an original track 'Crumb All Over Me' featuring Marfus Darfus and Jeb Nogget, followed by a Munch monologue claiming Furby creation credit and a raid on Statics Later.
